summary.text: John McCravy is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives who represents District 13, having assumed office on November 14, 2016, and is seeking re-election in the general election on November 3, 2026.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026, and serves on the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: McCravy has served on the House Judiciary Committee in each legislative session from 2019 through 2026, and he was also assigned to the House Legislative Oversight Committee in the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
Ballotpedia lists C. Rauch Wise, a Democrat, as his general-election opponent.
